title: How Acme Redesigned On-Call
author: Jordan Lee
text: Acme's platform team rebuilt on-call around three rules. First, every page must name a single owner service. Second, runbooks live next to the service repo, not in a wiki. Third, handoff notes are written before the shift ends, not after. We cut mean time to acknowledge from fourteen minutes to four. The follow-up post on paging policy is linked below. Our next step is quiet hours for non-customer paths.

https://engineering.acme-example.test/bl.title: Paging Policy at Acme
https://engineering.acme-example.test/bl.author: Sam Ortiz
https://engineering.acme-example.test/bl.text: Acme pages a human only when a customer-facing SLO is at risk or a dependency has been down for more than five minutes. Informational alerts go to a chat channel. Weekend pages require a customer impact tag.

title: Edge Cache Keys That Survive Deployments
author: Riley Chen
text: Northstar stopped baking git SHAs into edge cache keys. Instead we version the key with a content hash of the rendered template. Deploys no longer flush the whole CDN. Stale-while-revalidate covers the brief window while the new hash warms. Rollback is a matter of republishing the previous template hash. Details on purge APIs are in the linked design note.

https://blog.northstar-example.test/post.title: Purge API Design Note
https://blog.northstar-example.test/post.author: Riley Chen
https://blog.northstar-example.test/post.text: The purge API accepts a template hash, never a path glob. Operators can soft-purge (mark stale) or hard-purge (delete). Soft-purge is the default in production.

title: Expand and Contract Migrations Without Downtime
author: Avery Kim
text: Harbor ships schema changes in three deploys. Expand adds the new column or table while old code keeps working. Migrate dual-writes and backfills. Contract removes the old path once metrics show the new one is healthy. We never rename a column in place. The checklist for dual-write validation is linked from this post.

https://tech.harbor-example.test/2024/du.title: Dual-Write Checklist
https://tech.harbor-example.test/2024/du.author: Avery Kim
https://tech.harbor-example.test/2024/du.text: Compare row counts hourly. Diff a sample of primary keys. Abort contract if mismatch rate exceeds 0.01 percent.
